 Looking to use the cooler fall weather as an opportunity to get out and do more for your health? Supercharge your fitness journey with a new fitness tracker, particularly the Garmin Fenix 8, which is on sale now as an early Black Friday deal at Amazon. 
 As of Nov. 17, get the Garmin Fenix 8 for $749.99 at Amazon, down from its usual price of $999.99. That's $250 off and a discount of 25%. 
 The best tech deal this week 
 The Apple iPhone 18 Pro is free right now with T-Mobile 
 SEE ALSO: 
 We found 45 early Black Friday deals: $250 off MacBooks, live Lego discounts, and Kindles on sale 
 This premium fitness tracker has everything you need to get on track with taking care of your body or keep up what you're already working with. It's a multisport GPS-enabled watch that features a 1.4-inch AMOLED touchscreen, scratch-resistant sapphire lens, and titanium bezel. It also looks more like a regular watch than tracker, so if you're into that design this one should please you. 
 It can help you keep an eye on all your runs, biking treks, exercise sessions and more, with inReach satellite tech that can even keep you safe on your excursions. If something happens to you, it can send an SOS message to Garmin itself for 24/7 emergency assistance.

You can snag it at a great price right now, so if you're looking to upgrade your current tech or want something new to work with, now's the time to buy.
